messages:
Alex: Heads-up — our Dedicated canary in eu-west (pool a100-pool-3) started seeing multi-GPU jobs hang after the recent driver/CUDA upgrade. Driver bumped from 525.x -> 535.104 (CUDA 12.2), NCCL 2.20. Symptoms: ncclAllReduce stalls, NVLINK errors in dmesg.

Priya: Which nodes exactly and how many canaries?

Alex: 4 canary nodes (a100-80gb), node IDs: infra-eu-3-021, infra-eu-3-022, infra-eu-3-023, infra-eu-3-024. 2 of them show hangs, 2 seem OK.

Marco: Is this correlated with host kernel version? We had a mixed rollout to kernel 6.5 for newer images.

Alex: Yes — both failing nodes are on kernel 6.5. The healthy canaries are still on 5.15.

Jen: Pause the phased rollout and freeze canaries. If it's kernel+driver interaction we should not proceed.

Alex: Paused rollout now via rollout policy. infra-bot: deploy-bot has paused canary at 50%.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by Alex at 2024-03-30T20:16:07Z, reason: observed multi-GPU NCCL hangs.

Priya: Paste the relevant logs?

Alex: Logs snippet and `nvidia-smi` output below:
```
$ nvidia-smi -a
Driver Version: 535.104
CUDA Version: 12.2
GPU 0: A100-SXM-80GB
Processes: none (job shows hung on process that used to show busy)
```
And dmesg lines:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, pid=2345, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12345.679123] nvlink: error: failed link training on link 1
```

Marco: Sounds like NVLINK/driver handshake issue on kernel 6.5. We've seen similar at driver 535 in other vendors. We should validate whether NCCL 2.20 is sensitive here.

Priya: Can we run the nccl-tests container on an impacted node to reproduce? Command: `docker run --gpus all --rm -it nvcr.io/nvidia/nccl-tests:2.14 /bin/bash` and run `./build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 256M -f 2 -g 8`

Alex: I ran that; it hangs at setup on the two failed nodes. On 5.15 nodes it completes.

Jen: Action: rollback drivers on canary nodes to the last known-good driver (525.116) and re-run tests. Also open a bug with NVIDIA with dmesg and stacktrace.

Sasha: We should also check kernel modules: `modinfo nvidia` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`. If kernel ABI changed it could cause module mismatches.

Alex: Agreed. Proposed rollback playbook (short):
1) cordon + drain canary node (kubectl)
2) ssh into host, uninstall 535 driver (`/usr/bin/nvidia-uninstall --silent`)
3) install 525.116 package from internal repo (`apt install nvidia-driver-525=525.116-1`)
4) reboot host and verify `nvidia-smi` shows 525.116
5) run nccl-tests and a small sharded production test job (single tenant synthetic)
6) if stable, resume phased rollout but pin kernel to 5.15 for next batch or add kernel-driver compatibility gate

Marco: Add a verification step to upload kernel dmesg, journalctl -u kubelet logs, and nv-lspci output to the infra S3 bucket for postmortem.

Priya: I'm collecting coredumps + nv-hostengine logs now. Will attach to the ticket.

cs-lead: Heads-up — we need to notify Dedicated customers in eu-west with active reserved pools in case we schedule an emergency rollback window. I'll draft an advisory but keep it low-key until we confirm rollback plan.

Jen: Also update the rollout runbook: include a compatibility matrix (driver <-> CUDA <-> NCCL <-> kernel) and a pre-rollout smoke test that runs nccl-tests and a KV-cache eviction test.

Alex: I'm going to start the rollback on infra-eu-3-021 and infra-eu-3-022 now (one at a time). ETA ~30m per node (uninstall+install+reboot). Priya, Marco — can you run verification when they're back?

Priya: On it. I will also tail `dmesg -T -w` and run the nccl-test suite.

Marco: I'll run the perf/stress harness and then a 1-hour soak. If green, I'll sign off to resume.

Sasha: If rollback fixes it, we should block automatic rollouts for driver 535.* on all fleets until we get a signed compatibility statement from NVIDIA.

Alex: Agreed. I'll add a temporary cluster policy to block driver 535 images and update the canary config to require kernel=5.15 or explicit opt-in.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4371 "535 driver + kernel 6.5 -> NVLINK/NCCL hangs" assigned to Alex/Priya/Marco.

cs-lead: I'll hold off on customer comms until we have test pass/fail, but prep the template.

Alex: Update: rollback started on infra-eu-3-021 (1711234578). I'll post when verification done.

Jen: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short in this thread and escalate to incidents channel if we see wider impact. :thumbsup:
